title: 月之暗面估值飙至：500亿美元，能否追上720亿美金的同行？
speaker: Lienting To

segments.en: Definitely one of the most consequential IPOs out of the Chinese AI space. So the company is really having a great moment right now after the release of Kemi K3.
segments.zh: 这绝对是中国AI领域最具影响力的IPO之一。该公司在发布Kemi K3后正迎来高光时刻。

segments.en: It's getting raving reviews and people are talking about how it's going to stoke memory demand globally.
segments.zh: 它获得好评如潮，人们讨论它将如何刺激全球内存需求。

segments.en: So you know, it's finishing its current fundraising and valuing it at around $32 billion.
segments.zh: 它即将完成本轮融资，估值约320亿美元。

segments.en: And immediately, it's looking at another round in August, valuing it at $50 billion.
segments.zh: 紧接着，它计划8月再进行一轮融资，估值达500亿美元。

segments.en: Just to put that into perspective, Jiu Poo, its peer listed in Hong Kong, currently has a market cap about of about $72 billion.
segments.zh: 作为对比，其在香港上市的同行九毛九目前市值约720亿美元。

segments.en: So moonshot is not far behind, so definitely it will make moonshot one of the most valuable AI startups in China.
segments.zh: 因此Moonshot并不落后，这无疑将使其成为中国最具价值的AI初创公司之一。
